author: official
summary: Makes a grid's facet pills show only the cards in the chosen facet.
embed: One

attributes.name: data-dynamic-coral
attributes.description: Selects the grid-filter coral; on the filter bar inside a .st-grid.

attributes.name: data-cat
attributes.description: On each pill and card: its facet. A pill with an empty value shows every card.

requirements: Renderer output, not a standalone copy-paste embed. The renderer emits the mount point and the section's markup; sitetile's section component imports the client source and Astro bundles it into the page, and a Worker host serves the built artifact itself.
